comment: Asset keys the shim pre-loads through __crcbl_web_fetch_* before the demo boots. towers has none: its field is a ground slab, a lane, five build pads, the creeps and the towers, every one of them a crcbl::greybox primitive over a constant in apps/towers/src/map.rs, and its geometry, materials, shaders and font atlas are all compiled into the wasm module. The list is the seam, not the content.
